auth.login_tip: Login to use chat, library and the research workspace; admins can manage the document knowledge base.
auth.register_tip: Register to use chat, library and the research workspace; admins can manage the document knowledge base.
auth.hero_title: Turn a paper's conclusion into a traceable chain of evidence
auth.hero_desc: ResearchPilot is built for researchers: retrieval, extraction, comparison, verification and writing all happen on one chain, and every claim can be traced back to its source location.
auth.point_retrieval: Hybrid retrieval: vectors plus keywords, with explainable recall
auth.point_evidence: Citations verified one by one; unsupported claims are flagged
auth.point_workspace: From session to report, the research process stays traceable and reproducible

common.sample_hint: : this page is in place, but the data is a frontend placeholder and the API is not implemented yet.

chat.welcome_title: Start a research Q&A with traceable sources
chat.welcome_desc: Once you ask, I first retrieve the corpus and then answer with citations; every citation can be traced back to its source location.
chat.placeholder: Ask a research question... (Shift+Enter for new line)
chat.footer_hint: AI-generated content may contain errors. Please verify carefully; unverified citations are flagged separately.
chat.suggestion_1: Summarize the main conclusions about retrieval recall in the literature I uploaded
chat.suggestion_2: Which papers report citation precision, and are their definitions consistent?
chat.suggestion_3: Organize the evidence on chunking strategies into a comparison table

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Account, preferences, appearance and security; admins manage the knowledge base here.
settings.account_admin_hint: Admins can upload and delete knowledge base documents.
settings.account_user_hint: Users get chat, library and the research workspace; the knowledge base is maintained by admins.
settings.appearance_desc: The theme is stored on your account, so it follows you to other devices.
settings.prefs_desc: The page to open by default after login.
settings.password_desc: Your current session stays valid; use the new password from the next login.
settings.password_required: Enter your current and new password
settings.password_mismatch: The two new passwords do not match
settings.password_rule_hint: At least 8 characters, including at least two of lowercase letters, uppercase letters and digits.
settings.docs_desc: Upload and delete knowledge base documents (admin).
settings.delete_confirm_detail: Delete document "{name}"? This will also remove all related vectors from Milvus.

library.title: Library
library.desc: Indexed papers, topic clusters and automatic crawl sources. The paper list comes from a real API; topic clusters and crawl sources are sample data.

reader.title: Paper Reader
reader.desc: Body on the left, assistant on the right: every answer can jump back to a specific location in the PDF.
reader.sample_question: How much citation precision does the verifier add, and at what cost?
reader.sample_answer: The paper reports an 11.3-point drop in citation precision when the verifier is removed, and also points out that it never reports a recall floor, so the absolute meaning of the gain cannot be judged.
reader.field_question_value: Net contribution of the verifier to citation precision
reader.field_limitation_value: No recall floor reported; does not transfer across domains

compare.title: Multi-Paper Comparison Matrix
compare.desc: Align structured information across papers onto one set of dimensions, so conflicts are visible at a glance.

gaps.title: Gaps & Hypotheses
gaps.desc: Find the blanks in the evidence: candidate research questions, support strength and a hypothesis board.

graph.title: Dual Knowledge Graph & Evidence Chain
graph.desc: Navigate conclusions backwards: from a claim back to the evidence and source that support it.
graph.tension_note: Two evidence items conflict with the claim and need human adjudication.

runs.title: Autonomous Research Runs
runs.desc: Run goals, frontiers and budgets: long tasks the machine advances on its own live here.

lab.title: Research Lab
lab.desc: From reading to modeling and verification: experiment drafts, reproducible artifacts and failure records.
lab.artifacts_hint: Only with artifacts on disk does it count as reproducible

writing.title: Report Writing
writing.desc: Evidence-grounded writing: every sentence can still be traced back to the source it cites.
writing.preview_p1: This section reviews the current state of retrieval and chunking strategies and gives a unified set of comparison dimensions.
writing.preview_p2: Across all reviewed work, the verifier is used only as a precision patch, and a recall floor is never reported.
writing.preview_p3: Therefore, without a recall constraint, the precision gain from the verifier cannot be interpreted as a net benefit.

radar.title: Literature Radar
radar.desc: Long-term tracking: new papers, extensions, contradictions and retractions are aggregated here.

history.title: Chat History
history.desc: Every session lives here: open any one to keep asking, or delete the ones you no longer need.

workspace.title: Workspace
workspace.desc: Projects, tasks, notes and budget: the container for the research process.
workspace.budget_hint: Unit: hours. Runs that exceed the budget are paused.
